subject: What is the difference between mvpathreshold in part2 and threshold.vig  in part5?

messages.author: 48ecc1e3de37e653
messages.subject: What is the difference between mvpathreshold in part2 and threshold.vig  in part5?
parts:
Hello all,

I have some confusion maybe someone can help with....

What is the difference between mvpathreshold in part2 and threshold.vig  in part5?

So the mvpathreshold separates MVPA from Non MVPA and threshold.vig separates Moderate from Vigorous, (for different output variables?)
 if so should threshold.vig  be greater than mvpathreshold? 

It seems that for some variables moderate and vigorous activity is grouped together and sometimes vigorous is separated from moderate? 
If there is a threshold.vig why are there no corresponding boutcriter.vig and boutdur.vig? 


Also what are the default values for ilevels? 
Thanks!
Z

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] What is the difference between mvpathreshold in part2 and threshold.vig in part5?
parts:
Good question,
I implemented it in this way because I assumed that Physical activity
researchers are not interested in the distinction between non-bouted
and bouted vigorous physical activity.
Part 5 calculated time spent in vigorous activity, but when it comes
to bouted behavior it only looks at bouted mvpa, light and inactiivty
(sedentary).

Note that argument mvpathreshold is only used in part 2, because that
is how GGIR evolved.
Later when I added part 5 I created argument threshold.mod, which is
used in part5 for calculating timespent in MVPA.

ilevels does not have default values, because it is not calculated by default.

Best, Vincent
